sources.snippet: MuRIL is fine-tuned on Bhojpuri FiNE-MiBBiC dataset for Fine-grained Named Entity Recognition. FiNE-MiBBiC is an extension of SampurNER dataset which is created using the EaMaTa framework, utilizing the Few-NERD dataset.
